name: bb-plugin-chief-mode

bb.name: Chief mode [Experimental]
bb.description: Run a coordinator, a project chief per project and a task architect per bb Task as ordinary threads you can open and talk to. Roles live in thread metadata, so any thread can join; architects are attached to their tasks on the board, finished turns report up automatically, and a Chief page shows the live tree.

description: bb plugin: the Chief hierarchy (coordinator, project chiefs, task architects) as an overlay on ordinary, visible bb threads.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && bb plugin build
